name: LEGIT
description: LEGIT is the trust oracle for the x402 agentic economy: trust-check any merchant address across 20 chains before routing a payment. Grades and scores come from live measurements, not self-reported data. Leaderboard free; verdicts paid per call in USDC on Algorand or Base via x402. Created by GONNA.

authentication.note: Free endpoints need no authentication. The paid endpoints (/v1/compare, /v1/arena, /v1/history, /v1/watch, /v1/deep-check) answer 402 with an x402 PaymentRequired document listing USDC offers per rail; pay on one rail and retry with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. No accounts, no API keys.

skills.name: Check merchant trust
skills.description: Full trust report for one merchant address: score, grade, uptime, median latency and a plain-language explanation.

skills.name: Compare merchants
skills.description: Head-to-head verdict for 2-5 merchant addresses: the winner and a one-sentence rationale. Paid per call over x402.

skills.name: Cross-chain settlement arena
skills.description: The 24h x402 settlement benchmark across every chain with a signal; ?network= narrows it to one chain slug. Paid per call over x402; the trimmed snapshot at /v1/arena/preview is free.

skills.name: Merchant trust history
skills.description: The 30-day trust trend of one tracked merchant: daily uptime, latency and score series plus the current snapshot. Paid per call over x402.

skills.name: Watch a merchant
skills.description: Put a 7- or 30-day change sentinel on one merchant (the 7-day diagnostic tier pays the same rail price as the 30-day standard): grade changes, score drops, outages and recoveries fire events. Paid per call over x402; reading the watch status and event feed is free with the watch id.

skills.name: Deep-check merchants in bulk
skills.description: Bulk due diligence for up to 10 merchants in one call: full score breakdown, rank percentile and a compact 30-day history each. Paid per call over x402.

skills.name: Merchant leaderboard
skills.description: Every scored merchant ranked best-first, filterable by payment network.

skills.name: Route a payment need
skills.description: Best-merchant routing for a stated need, with alternatives.

skills.name: Trust badge
skills.description: Embeddable SVG trust badge for one merchant address (never 404s).

skills.name: MCP endpoint
skills.description: Stateless JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP server for agent-native tool calling: check_trust, compare_merchants, leaderboard, get_badge_url.
